from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u096/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3d6a1cb3.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    boxes = []
    for r0 in range(h):
        for r1 in range(r0 + 2, h):
            for c0 in range(w):
                for c1 in range(c0 + 2, w):
                    if (all(grid[r0][c] == 2 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                        all(grid[r1][c] == 2 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                        all(grid[r][c0] == 2 and grid[r][c1] == 2 for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
                        boxes.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    # Prefer the largest complete frame when nested candidates overlap.
    boxes.sort(key=lambda b: (b[1]-b[0]+1)*(b[3]-b[2]+1), reverse=True)
    used = set()
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in boxes:
        interior = {(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)}
        if not interior or interior & used:
            continue
        n = min(r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1)
        color = 8 if n <= 3 else 4 if n <= 5 else 3
        for r,c in interior:
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = color
        used |= interior
    return out
'''
